info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Melilite Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Catalog Management API facilitates the creation of detailed product entries for the Melilite Recliner. This endpoint allows businesses to input, update, and enhance the product information, which is essential for effective inventory management and customer engagement. Users such as retailers and inventory managers can utilize this API to ensure that product details are accurate and up-to-date. By leveraging this functionality, companies can streamline catalog updates and improve the overall shopping experience.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create details for a Melilite recliner. It takes the necessary information and records it, facilitating the management and customization of recliner products.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for the Melilite recliner. The input should include all required fields related to the recliner's specifications, preferences, and configurations.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested details.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the melilite recliner.
